items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: And another brother-in-law, Henry Julian, saxophones.

ctx.x: Did you, uh, have any musicians in your family?
No. He was my brother-in-law, but my wife's brother, Frank Crump. Who was he? And another brother-in-law, Henry Julian, saxophones.
